purpose: Rights-checked acquisition queue for expanding Mercy's local patristic primary-text corpus. Entries remain pending until a stable reusable text source is ingested and validated.
policy: Prefer scans or transcriptions of historical public-domain editions from repositories that state reuse rights clearly.
Do not copy modern introductions, annotations, translations, website descriptions or database enhancements unless separately licensed.
Keep original ancient work, historical translation, modern editorial material and Mercy metadata distinct.
Record volume, editor, translator when identifiable, publication date, host, rights evidence, checksum and acquisition date.
Do not mark a Father as locally available until the actual text files have been generated under data/patristic-corpus and pass validation.
